import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    df = inputs["RATE_FEED"].copy()

    # Preserve stable ordering exactly as legacy cursor: ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to preserve any tie order deterministically
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account_id group (carry never crosses accounts)
    grouped = df.groupby("account_id", sort=False)["rate"]
    rate_filled = grouped.ffill()

    # was_carried = 1 if original rate was NULL but a carried-forward value exists
    was_carried = ((df["rate"].isna()) & (rate_filled.notna())).astype("int64")

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": df["account_id"],
        "obs_seq": df["obs_seq"],
        "obs_date": df["obs_date"],
        "rate_filled": rate_filled,
        "was_carried": was_carried,
    })

    return {"rate_filled": out}
